name: Essentials

features.text: Nearby inventory aggregation, Equipped view, exact-minute watch clock, selection repair and automatic key filing.
Device-owned menus, matching-magazine actions, craft output routing, hotbar ordering, map defaults, literature/media progress and context grouping.
Bounded seeded-container sorting with server-side access/capacity checks and committed-ownership replication; property-driven native ladder context actions.
Cycle-safe inventory traversal, exact actor/nested/world/vehicle/corpse references and bounded replay-aware batch transport. No UI automatically invokes general batch transfers.
Heavy-object provider observations and authoritative reserve/start/complete/cancel lifecycle; no production physics provider or generic movement engine.
Fail-closed independent-hand equipment classification only; no dual-wield attacks, reloads, animations or input integration.
Ear-protector audio needs a verified reversible Lua-accessible diegetic listener path. Camera/visibility Java proposals are superseded by Lua-only policy.
Automatic traversal needs verified consumable input and safe native transition hooks; context-action support does not prove these capabilities.

limits: Reviewed source description only. 0.19.0 SP and dedicated multiplayer NOT TESTED; G7 and stable G8 BLOCKED. Rename requires coordinated mod lists, sandbox presets and consumers. Legacy powerWorks adapter compatibility with renamed Power is unverified. No hard mod dependencies.

relations.text: Device-menu and watch adapters probe the legacy powerWorks namespace/provider contract. No current renamed-Power compatibility or runtime connection is claimed.
